SR-G2.ko: 살아 있는 뿔에서 뿌리가 뻗어 숨을 빨아들임
SR-G2.equip: a living wooden antler is set in place with a woody knock, roots creep out with slow creaks, and a soft sucking rustle draws inward like breath being pulled

G2-02.ko: 작은 이끼 몸이 철퍼덕 · 푹 터지고 머리 딸깍이며 다시 돋음
G2-02.atk: a tiny pale spirit rattles its head with a dry seed-pod clatter, flings itself forward in a puff of spores and lands a soft mossy slap
G2-02.def: no real block, the spongy body bursts: a muffled wet pop, moss crumbs pattering down, then faint hollow clicks as tiny shoots sprout back

G2-03.ko: 서툰 활시위 튕김 · 놀라 휘청이며 잔가지 밟음
G2-03.atk: a thin green bow creaks and a clumsy string twangs, a short arrow whistles through low leaves, then lands with a small light thock
G2-03.def: no armour, it flinches: a startled troll huff, a quiver rattling on its back, a stumble that snaps a dry twig underfoot

G2-04.ko: 덩굴 채찍으로 톡 감김 · 가시 덩굴이 먼저 깨어 찌름
G2-04.atk: a slender wooden arm flicks out a vine with a soft rustling whip and a light stinging lash
G2-04.def: the dryad sways back like a sapling: a light woody tock, then the vines around her snap awake with a dry thorny prickle against the attacker

G2-05.ko: 어린 가지 팔로 톡 · 줄기가 텅 울리고 뿌리 꿈틀
G2-05.atk: a sapling-thin branch arm swings with a soft creak and a light whoosh, ending in a springy wooden thwack
G2-05.def: partial block with a slender trunk: a hollow wooden tock, roots shuffling nervously in loose soil, young leaves quivering

G2-08.ko: 삽 지팡이로 흙 내리침 · 이끼 어깨로 받고 꽃잎
G2-08.atk: a gravedigger's gnarled digging staff swings low with a heavy whoosh, bites into earth with a dull thump, and scatters a soft patter of petals
G2-08.def: takes the blow on a thick mossy shoulder: a damp muffled thud, a deep gentle troll grumble, then flower petals drifting down

G2-09.ko: 발굽으로 뛰어올라 뿔로 받음 · 나무껍질 방패로 막음
G2-09.atk: a quick trill of reed pipes, springing hooves clattering on roots, then a butting thrust of curled horns with a hard woody knock
G2-09.def: a bark shield takes the blow: a hollow wooden thock, a startled bleat-like laugh, hooves skittering in leaf litter

G2-11.ko: 갓을 흔들어 포자를 퍽 · 물컹한 몸으로 받아냄
G2-11.atk: a squat cap wobbles with a damp creak, then a soft puff of spores and a spongy bump against the target
G2-11.def: the blow sinks into soft fungal flesh: a deep muffled squelch, gills fluttering, a slow spongy rebound and spores drifting down

G2-13.ko: 가지 위에서 거미줄을 쏘아 휘감음 · 나무껍질 같은 몸으로 받음
G2-13.atk: legs skitter over bark, a taut silk line twangs as it shoots down from the branches, then the target is wrapped with a sticky stretching hiss
G2-13.def: a bark-patterned carapace takes the blow: a hard chitin knock, eight legs scrabbling for grip, a sharp clicking hiss

G2-15.ko: 뿔을 낮추고 돌진해 들이받음 · 뿔로 걸어 받음
G2-15.atk: a ringing bell call echoes through the trees, hooves drum on soft loam, then branching antlers crash into the target with a woody clatter
G2-15.def: it lowers its antlers to catch the blow: a sharp antler-on-steel clack, a snort, hooves sliding through wet leaves

G2-17.ko: 씹던 이끼를 뱉어 포자탄 · 포자 구름으로 푹신하게 막음
G2-17.atk: a wet chewing of moss, a gloopy spit, then a green spore bolt flies with a hissing whoosh and bursts in a damp muffled puff
G2-17.def: a thick cloud of spores billows up as a cushion: a spongy muffled thud, a low gurgling grumble, fine dust settling softly

G2-20.ko: 낮게 으르렁대다 덮쳐 할퀴고 묾 · 몸을 틀어 받고 포효
G2-20.atk: a low rolling growl from the undergrowth, padded paws on a wooden stair, a sudden pounce and a raking claw strike with a deep bite
G2-20.def: it twists its striped body to take the hit: a heavy thump on dense fur, a snarl breaking into a roar, claws scraping on bark

G2-21.ko: 고목 팔을 들어 내리찍음 · 줄기가 깊게 울리며 갈라짐
G2-21.atk: a slow, angry timber groan as an oak arm winds back, a thunderous overhead slam, then bark shards and acorns pattering down
G2-21.def: no armour but a huge trunk: a deep resonant boom through the whole body, a splintering crack along the bark, a long grieved groan

G2-22.ko: 흙에서 뽑혀 나오며 날카로운 비명 · 뿌리 몸으로 둔탁하게 받음
G2-22.atk: soil tears with a wet rip, a piercing shriek rises from a gaping root mouth, then a gnarled root fist lands with an earthy knock
G2-22.def: the gnarled root body takes the hit: a dull earthy thud, root hairs snapping, clods of soil pattering down and a low muttering groan

G2-23.ko: 낙엽 소용돌이가 돌며 수액 파동 · 잎 장막이 스르륵
G2-23.atk: a swirling gust of leaves spirals up around her branch-like arms, then releases a deep pressure whump of green sap energy
G2-23.def: a curtain of leaves rustles up around her bark body, dew drops shimmer glassily, and the blow dissolves into a soft muffled thud

G2-25.ko: 옛 나무 뿔가지로 휘둘러 내리침 · 깊은 고목 울림
G2-25.atk: an ancient forked branch heaves with a deep creaking groan and a low green hum, then swings down with a heavy wooden crack and a burst of rustling leaves
G2-25.def: dense old wood takes the blow: a deep resonant knock like a temple pillar, moss puffing, then a soft creak as fresh shoots unfurl

G2-26.ko: 머리 딸깍이는 메아리가 바람으로 침 · 고목 속으로 숨어 받음
G2-26.atk: a chorus of dry head rattles echoes from an old trunk, a hollow knocking builds, then a wave of whispering wind slaps into the target
G2-26.def: it shrinks back into the old tree: a deep hollow wooden knock, a soft echoing click, leaves shivering overhead

G2-27.ko: 숲 바람 속삭임이 막음 틈으로 파고듦 · 이끼 수염 흔들리며 받음
G2-27.atk: a distant echoing call through the trees, a rising whisper of wind in branches, then a twisting creak of wood that lashes past any guard with a sharp snap
G2-27.def: its bark body creaks under the blow: a muffled woody thud, a rustle of moss beard and leaves, and a low amused hum

G2-28.ko: 뿌리 몸으로 천천히 들이밂 · 땅에 박힌 채 받아냄
G2-28.atk: deep roots tear free of the earth with a slow groan, a heavy shuffling step, then a crushing root-bound shove with a dull timber thud
G2-28.def: it sinks deeper into the soil: a heavy earthy thump, roots creaking taut, stones grinding in the tangle

G2-30.ko: 몸을 말아 가시째 굴러 들이받음 · 공처럼 말아 가시로 막음
G2-30.atk: a snuffling huff, a quick scuttle through leaf litter, then it rolls into the target with a dry rattling scrape of thorns
G2-30.def: it curls into a ball: a crisp thorny bristle as the blow lands, spines clicking and creaking, and a muffled snuffle from inside

G2-31.ko: 잎사귀 팔로 휩쓸어 내리침 · 잎이 흩어졌다 다시 피어남
G2-31.atk: a deep leafy rustle as a foliage arm sweeps out, a whisper of many voices, then a heavy green slam with a burst of petals
G2-31.def: leaves scatter around the blow with a soft papery rustle, then blossoms pop back open one by one with tiny wet clicks

G2-32.ko: 아주 느린 거대 내리침 · 동굴처럼 깊은 줄기 울림
G2-32.atk: a vast, very slow groan from deep in the trunk, a colossal limb falling with a ground-shaking slam, and a long rolling rumble after
G2-32.def: a cavernous boom swallows the hit, enormous wood creaks as it settles, and a drizzle of bark dust and leaves falls in the stillness

G2-33.ko: 느려진 시간 속 나무 팔 일격 · 오래 늘어지는 나무 울림
G2-33.atk: a slender wooden arm draws back with a long slowed creak, a strange stretched whoosh, then a solid wooden strike that echoes as if from far away
G2-33.def: her bark skin takes the hit: a hollow woody knock that rings on too long, leaves drifting slowly down, and a faint warping hum

G2-34.ko: 새잎 돋은 뿔로 돌진 · 뿔로 걸어 받고 휘청
G2-34.atk: a long belling call, hooves pounding the loam, then branch-like antlers thrust in with a hard woody thock as fresh leaves unfurl at their tips with a delicate rustle
G2-34.def: no solid guard, the stag catches the blow on its antlers: a clacking knock of old wood, a snort, hooves staggering in wet leaves

G2-35.ko: 고목들이 느리게 삐걱이다 마력 · 거대한 합쳐진 울림
G2-35.atk: many old trunks creak in a slow overlapping swell, branches rubbing, then a deep sap-heavy magic pulse rolls outward
G2-35.def: a ring of ancient trunks closes ranks with grinding timber, the hit vanishes into a massive hollow thud, and a patient groan answers

G2-36.ko: 땅 밑 균사가 고동치며 솟아 덮침 · 고동 소리로 받아냄
G2-36.atk: a deep muffled heartbeat thumps under the soil, white threads tear upward with a fibrous rip, then a spongy mass slams down with a heavy squelch
G2-36.def: the blow sinks into a pulsing fungal mass: a dense wet thud, the heartbeat stumbles then steadies, spores sighing out

G2-41.ko: 가지를 꺾어 창 던짐 · 땅에 박혀 뿌리 내림
G2-41.atk: a branch snaps over a knee with a dry crack, the spear is hurled with a hard whoosh, and it pierces through with a sharp thunk
G2-41.def: thin and unarmoured, it dodges: a sudden leap, a leafy scramble, the blow brushing past with a whiff and a small startled grunt

G2-42.ko: 말벌 떼가 웅 하고 쏘아 꿰뚫음 · 흩어졌다 다시 뭉침
G2-42.atk: a rising angry buzz, a rapid dive of countless wings, then a pattering of sharp stings that pierce through with tiny hard ticks
G2-42.def: the swarm bursts apart in a scattering buzz, a few thin pops of crushed insects, then the wings regroup into a tight whirring hum

G2-43.ko: 탄 나무가 돌진해 박살 · 숯 부스러지고 불씨 튐
G2-43.atk: a charred half-trunk charges with crackling charcoal and a smoldering hiss, then rams through with a splitting crash
G2-43.def: the burnt half crumbles: charcoal falling in brittle chunks, ember ticks hissing, and a sullen groan from the living half

SP-G2.ko: 은빛 파동과 가시 휘두름 · 상처가 달빛 속에 아묾
SP-G2.atk: a silvery rising shimmer, a thorn-laced arm sweeps with a hard burning-wood crack, and a glassy lunar ring blooms over the impact
SP-G2.def: a cold moonlit shimmer, bark spines crackle as the blow lands, then the split wood creaks and knits closed with a soft rustle of regrowing leaves

UN-G2.en: Thorn Keeper of the First Tree
UN-G2.ko: 가시덤불 벽이 닫히며 조임 · 베어도 뿌리가 다시 이어짐
UN-G2.atk: a hedge of brambles closes in with a dry rattle, tangling and crushing together with a tight thorny creak and a rending snap
UN-G2.def: the cut vines fall with a snip, then roots re-knit underground with wet creaking and a slow knotting of wood, thorns springing back

UN-G2-7.ko: 씨앗 주머니 휘둘러 흩뿌림 · 싹이 터 올라 막음
UN-G2-7.atk: a seed pouch swings from a branch with a dry rattle, a spray of seeds hisses through the air, then they thud into the foe and pop with tiny green sprouts
UN-G2-7.def: the old treant's trunk creaks under the hit with a low groan, the seed pouches rattle, and sprouts burst up around it in a creaking green shield

EP-G2-1.ko: 녹슨 가시 덩굴로 휘감아 조임 · 쇠가시가 되찌르고 덩굴이 다시 자람
EP-G2-1.atk: rust-stained vines drag forward with a rasping hiss, coil around the target with a tightening creak, then iron-hard thorns bite in with a metallic scrape
EP-G2-1.def: the blow cuts into the tangle: a dry thorny crackle that stabs back with a metallic tick, then cut tendrils re-knit with wet creaking

EP-G2-2.ko: 높은 가지에서 활을 쏘고 가시창을 던짐 · 잎이 덮여 숨음
EP-G2-2.atk: a living-wood bow creaks high in the canopy, an arrow whistles down and thunks deep, then a thorn javelin follows with a whooshing throw and a hard crack
EP-G2-2.def: leaves rush in to cover her: a soft papery rustle, the blow landing with a muffled woody tock, bark creaking as she shifts behind the trunk

EP-G2-3.ko: 고목 거인이 땅을 내리밟음 · 쪼개진 나무가 다시 붙음
EP-G2-3.atk: a giant root-foot plants with an earth-cracking stomp, a branch-laden arm swings with a deep roar of wind, and smashes down with a thundering crunch
EP-G2-3.def: the impact lands on solid wood with a heavy boom, long spines burst out with a snarling crackle, then deep timber groans as the split trunk knits back together

PN-G2-C1.ko: 잔가지 톡 · 잘려도 낭창 튕기며 새순 돋음
PN-G2-C1.atk: a tiny twig flicks out with a light whip and a small tick, brushing the target with a faint leafy tap
PN-G2-C1.def: cut stems snip with a soft crisp sound, the stalk bounces springily, and a squeaky creak shows it growing right back to height

PN-G2-C2.ko: 가시덤불이 기어와 할큄 · 뿌리가 깊어지며 가시로 되찌름
PN-G2-C2.atk: a mass of briars drags itself forward with a dry rattling scrape, then lashes out with a thorny whip and a stinging snap
PN-G2-C2.def: the briars take the blow and dig in: roots creaking deeper into the soil, a prickling crackle of thorns stabbing back

PN-G2-C3.ko: 여러 머리가 번갈아 물어뜯음 · 굵은 목으로 받고 쉭쉭
PN-G2-C3.atk: several hissing heads rise out of murky water with a wet slosh, then snap in quick succession with heavy biting crunches
PN-G2-C3.def: scaly necks take the blow: a meaty thud, an angry chorus of hisses, mud sucking at its bulk and water sloshing

PN-G2-U1.ko: 날갯짓하며 가시 화살을 쏨 · 덩굴손이 상처를 묶음
PN-G2-U1.atk: a quick buzzing flutter of leaf wings, a tiny twig bow creaks, then a thorn dart whistles off with a high thin zip and a sharp tick
PN-G2-U1.def: no real armour, the pixie is knocked spinning: a light papery flap, a squeak, then tendrils whisper tight around the wound

PN-G2-U2.ko: 균사 다발로 휘감아 조임 · 뿌리처럼 박혀 가시 포자로 되찌름
PN-G2-U2.atk: white mycelium threads lash out with a fibrous whip, wrap the target with a soft tightening creak, then cinch hard with a damp crunch
PN-G2-U2.def: it is anchored like a root: a dull spongy thud, threads straining taut, then a hiss of prickling spores bursting back at the attacker

PN-G2-R.ko: 젖은 이끼 주먹이 철퍼덕 · 이끼 속 가시가 찌름
PN-G2-R.atk: a huge fist of soaked moss swings with a wet whoosh and lands with a heavy squelching splat that drips and sprays
PN-G2-R.def: thick moss cushions the blow in a spongy muffled thud, then hidden spines poke through with tiny dry pricks and a rustle of memory-laden leaves

PN-G2-E.ko: 숲이 자란 뿔로 들이받음 · 가시가 되찌르고 이끼가 상처를 덮음
PN-G2-E.atk: a deep belling call shakes leaves loose, heavy hooves pound the loam, then a crown of mossy antlers crashes through with a splintering clatter
PN-G2-E.def: the blow lands on moss-draped antlers and hide: a dense muffled thump, thorns in the moss snapping back with a prickly crackle, then a soft creeping rustle as new moss closes over

UP-G2-17.ko: 이끼 바닥이 일어서 덮침 · 두꺼운 이끼 층이 겹겹이 막음
UP-G2-17.atk: a carpet of moss swells up and rolls forward with a thick sucking squelch, then breaks over the target in a heavy smothering rustle
UP-G2-17.def: layers of moss pile up around him one after another with soft wet slaps, the blow dying in a very deep muffled thump and a pleased low grumble

UP-G2-22.ko: 땅을 찢고 비명 지르며 뿌리 주먹 · 뒤엉킨 뿌리 몸이 받음
UP-G2-22.atk: soil tears with a deep wet rip, a piercing shriek rises from a gaping root mouth, then a huge gnarled root fist lands with a heavy earthy knock
UP-G2-22.def: the gnarled root body takes the hit: a dull earthy thud, root hairs snapping, clods of soil pattering down and a low muttering groan

UP-G2-23.ko: 세 갈래 잎 회오리가 하나로 · 겹겹 잎 장막과 수액 파동
UP-G2-23.atk: three streams of leaves whirl into a single roaring spiral, then a sap-heavy green blast slams outward with a deep concussive boom
UP-G2-23.def: layered veils of leaves rustle up in sequence, dew droplets shimmer, and the strike dissolves into a deep soft swell of sap

SG2-01.cast: a vine slithers out of the soil with a wet rustle, wedges into a steel armor seam with a scraping creak, then squeezes tight until the metal groans and buckles with a dull crunch

SG2-02.ko: 껍질 갑옷 틈에서 새순이 돋아 상처를 덮음
SG2-02.cast: old bark plates settle onto a chest with a dry wooden clack, then cracks creak open as fresh shoots burst out with soft leafy unfurling rustles and a moist sap squelch knitting closed

SG2-03.cast: thorny brambles sprout in the dark with quick crackling pops, tangling taller and denser into a rattling hedge, ending with a dry settling of spines

MG-08.cast: roots rip upward from deep earth with a muffled tearing rumble, snake around ankles with rough scraping creaks, and cinch tight with a gripping wooden squeak

SG2-04.cast: roots pull free from soil with sucking tearing pops, heavy trunks groan to a stand, and slow thunderous footsteps rumble onward while branches creak and swell

SG2-05.ko: 여러 트롤의 수액이 뿌리를 타고 한 고목으로 몰려 부풀어 오름
SG2-05.cast: several slow draining glugs of thick sap sucked away through creaking roots, converging into one deep swelling wooden groan that inflates and tightens like a straining trunk

MC-11.ko: 숲이 숨을 멈추고 소리가 눌려 꺼짐
MC-11.cast: the forest's rustling suddenly sinks into a hush: leaves still, a dull muffled pressure squeezes, swords fall silent with a faint dull clunk, and a deep sinking drain follows

MG-10.cast: ancient branches sag and sweep down with a long heavy rustle, interlace into a drooping curtain of leaves, and tiny thorns tick as they set

SG2-07.cast: thistle stalks burst up with fast crisp snaps and grow into tall rustling walls, stiff spiky heads clacking together as the fortress stiffens and settles

MC-14.cast: a rush of countless vines sweeps across the ground with a heavy rustle, wraps whole suits of armor and wrenches them with groaning metal creaks, plates popping loose and clanking down into soft moss

MG-14.cast: a deep groaning of many trunks leaning at once, a slow rolling avalanche of wood and moss, then successive crushing thuds moving down a line

SG2-08.cast: roots tearing out of soil with a cracking rip, a huge wooden creak as a trunk rears up, then a colossal earth-shaking thud and crumbling soil, bark splitting off in a dry crack

SG2-09.cast: a fallen branch thumps into soil, sends up a fast creaking trunk with a swelling groan, and thorny boughs spread with a crackling rustle overhead

RG2-1.ko: 숲이 숨을 죽여 칼이 멎고 정적이 적을 짓누름
RG2-1.cast: all ambient sound is sucked away with a low swelling hush, blades and wings stall with faint clinks, then a heavy silent pressure presses down on the foe with deep crushing creaks of wood

NG2-1.ko: 뿌리가 땅 밑에서 솟아 갑옷 틈마다 박힘
NG2-1.cast: a deep earthy rumble of roots tunnelling underground, then several roots burst up with crumbling soil and drive into armor joints with sharp wooden cracks and metal scrapes

NG2-3.cast: a severed limb creaks as green shoots push out with wet tender cracks, wood knits together with a warm rustling squeak, and a deep resolute grumble answers

US-G2-1.ko: 베인 가지가 붙고 그 몸에 가시가 돋음
US-G2-1.cast: a warm wind rustles through the grove, split branches creak and rejoin with wooden clicks on one trunk, and a prickling crackle of new thorns bursts along its bark

US-G2-2.ko: 천 년 고목이 뿌리째 걸어 나옴
US-G2-2.cast: a thousand-year trunk groans awake, roots rip free from earth with a deep tearing roar, and a shuddering step shakes the ground with a rolling boom

PS-G2-1.cast: a slow concentric tightening of wood: layer upon layer creaks and swells around the trunk, each ring closing with a firm low knock and a settling groan

PS-G2-2.ko: 발이 땅에 묻혀 나무가 되어 버팀
PS-G2-2.cast: boots sink into soil with a squelch, toes split into roots that grind downward, and the body stiffens into bark with a long dry creak

RS-G2-1.ko: 뿌리가 적 뒤에서 솟아 수액을 빨아올림
RS-G2-1.cast: roots crawl underground with a muffled scraping rumble, burst up behind the foe with a ripping thump, then sap pulls upward with a gulping slurp

RS-G2-2.ko: 숲길이 덤불로 닫혀 벤 만큼 찔림
RS-G2-2.cast: a woodland path swallows itself in a rapid snapping growth, brambles knit together with a rough scraping rustle, and briars rake back as a blade chops into them

RS-G2-3.ko: 이끼가 아군을 덮어 쓰러지지 못하게 붙듦
RS-G2-3.cast: damp moss spreads in a soft wet crawl across bodies, binding them with a spongy swelling creak, and a deep stubborn root-groan holds firm as a blow lands and fails to topple them

CS-G2.ko: 이끼가 주문을 덮어 꺼뜨리고 상처를 아물림
CS-G2.cast: thick moss slaps over a crackling spell with a smothering wet squelch, the sparks fizzle out into a damp hiss, and underneath wounds knit with a soft creak

IG2-1.equip: a thorny pattern sprouts across skin with tiny scratchy pricks, a faint scrape of a needle-like carving, and in use a quick prickling tick when struck

IG2-2.equip: a rough bark pattern is pressed onto the arm with a dry scraping crunch, spreading and hardening with a soft layered creak, tapping hollow like wood afterwards

IG2-3.equip: braided moss is looped over the neck with a soft damp rustle, its tiny knots cinch with a squeak, and it pulses with a faint shimmering hush

I3-3.ko: 긴 활에 시위를 걸고 한 번 당겨 봄
I3-3.equip: a tall bow of pale wood is strung with a tense creak, the string plucks a deep test thrum, and a well-oiled limb flexes with a smooth wooden sigh

IG2-4.equip: thistle stalks woven into a cuirass are cinched over the chest with a dry squeaking rustle, spiky heads clicking together, and a prickly crackle when it settles

IG2-5.ko: 씨앗을 심장 옆에 심자 숨결이 퍼짐
IG2-5.equip: a small seed is pressed against the ribs with a soft thump, a damp earthy crackle of a root taking hold, and a slow warm throb of new growth

IG2-6.ko: 용의 뿌리가 혈관을 따라 뻗어 듦
IG2-6.equip: a long pale root creeps along an arm with a slow stretching creak, tiny rootlets pop through skin with a wet crackle, and a deep faint rumble hums within

M4-1.ko: 천 년 나이테가 몸에 한 겹씩 새겨짐
M4-1.equip: concentric ring grooves are carved into the chest with slow gouging scrapes, each ring knocks hollow and thick, and a deep ancient creak settles into the body

IR-G2.ko: 첫 고목이 스스로 떨군 껍질을 두름
IR-G2.equip: a huge old slab of bark drops from a trunk with a splitting thud, wraps around the shoulders with a rough heavy scrape, and blade-sized thorns tick outward

PI-G2.equip: a glowing first seed is pushed into the chest with a soft glassy shimmer, a trunk-deep creak spreads outward, and new wood and leaves keep knitting and swelling with a living rustle

TK-G2-1.atk: a short curtain of vines whips forward with a rustling lash, tapping the target with a light wet slap before it droops
TK-G2-1.def: no armour but a thick green lattice: vines absorb the blow with squeaky stretching, thump softly, then wither with a dry crisp rattle

TK-U-ROOT.ko: 뿌리가 땅에서 쑥 뻗어 툭 침 · 베여도 꿈틀
TK-U-ROOT.atk: a root rises from the soil with a muffled tearing sound and jabs forward with a stubby woody thud and a dirty patter of soil
TK-U-ROOT.def: cut roots snap with a damp crack, bits writhe and squirm in the dirt, then a slow soft creak shows them creeping back

TK-U-SAPLING.ko: 작은 묘목이 가냘프게 휘며 톡 · 흙에 박혀 섬
TK-U-SAPLING.atk: a green sapling bends and snaps forward with a light springy swish, a gentle leafy tap on the target, a few leaves fluttering
TK-U-SAPLING.def: the thin stem bends flat under the hit with a squeaky creak, soil shifts around its base, and it springs back up with a soft rustle

TK-U-TREE.ko: 자란 고목이 가지로 쿵 · 줄기로 단단히 받음
TK-U-TREE.atk: a grown young trunk swings a thick low branch with a firm creak and a solid wooden whump, ending in a rattle of falling leaves
TK-U-TREE.def: a sturdy young trunk takes the blow with a dense knock, bark shifts with a short grinding creak, and resin gurgles faintly in the grain
